nodes.summary: For a finite subset $A$ of a type with a multiplication, the product set $A \cdot A$ is the finite set $\{ab : a, b \in A\}$ of all products of two elements of $A$.
nodes.title: Product set of a finite set

nodes.summary: For every real $C \ge 1$ there are a real $\delta > 0$ and a natural number $P_0$ such that for every prime $p \ge P_0$ and every finite subset $A$ of $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{F}_p)$, where $\mathbb{F}_p = \mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$, with $C^{-1} p^{5/2} \le |A| \le C p^{5/2}$, the product set $A \cdot A = \{ab : a, b \in A\}$ satisfies $|A \cdot A| > p^{5/2 + \delta}$.
nodes.title: Sets of size about $p^{5/2}$ in $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{F}_p)$ grow under multiplication

nodes.summary: The statement that for every real $C \ge 1$ there are a real $\delta > 0$ and a natural number $P_0$ such that for every prime $p \ge P_0$ and every finite subset $A$ of $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{F}_p)$, where $\mathbb{F}_p = \mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$, with $C^{-1} p^{5/2} \le |A| \le C p^{5/2}$, the product set $A \cdot A = \{ab : a, b \in A\}$ satisfies $|A \cdot A| > p^{5/2 + \delta}$.
nodes.title: Two-step product growth in $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{F}_p)$ (AIM Problem 3.4)
